shareId.title: Share ID
shareId.description: The short alphanumeric token from your Nee-Vo share URL (e.g. 'FJZvjg' from https://nv.otodata.com/d/FJZvjg)

tankCapacityGallons.title: Tank Capacity (gallons)
tankCapacityGallons.description: Total capacity of your propane tank in gallons. Used to calculate gallons remaining.

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to check the propane level in minutes. Minimum 60 (the sensor updates at most once per hour). Default is 1440 (24 hours).

lowThreshold.title: Low Level Threshold (%)
lowThreshold.description: Percentage below which the low propane alert triggers in HomeKit automations. Default is 30.

apiBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the Nee-Vo API. Only change this if the endpoint moves. Default: https://nv.otodata.com/api/devices
